title: Exploratory reported-loss classifier
status: retrospective research; not an operational alert or farmer score

target.excluded: Blank, nonnumeric, negative, or missing plot-key responses
target.unit: Unconfirmed; not interpreted as kilograms or as a national loss rate
target.interpretation: Presence of a positive reported value in the same survey, not loss severity, a forecast, or a confirmed kilogram quantity.

training.season_c_excluded: Restricted sample; kept out of this exploratory model.
training.evaluation: 5-fold stratified group cross-validation. All records sharing Segment_ID + s2q1 stay in the same fold.
leakage_controls: Excluded s2q39-derived and post-harvest fields s2q40–s2q50.
Excluded row identifiers and grouping keys from model features.
Survey weights are not applied; scores are not population estimates.
No respondent-level score is shown on this website.

operating_point.selection_rule: Fixed 0.5 threshold reported for comparison with the always-negative baseline. Retraining can replace this with a maximum-F1 threshold.

reading_for_users: Accuracy is high because most records report zero. That does not mean the model finds most positive-loss records.
ROC AUC 0.85 and average precision 0.37 are above the always-negative baseline (0.50 and 0.08). The model has some ranking skill on this sample.
At a 0.5 cutoff, recall is only 9.3%. Most positive reports are missed. This is not ready as an alert system.
This is a same-survey classification, not a prediction of next season’s loss, and not a score of farmers.
hackathon_use: Shown only as grouped methods evidence for Track 1. Crop pages use survey shares and a transparent follow-up signal, not this classifier’s individual probabilities.
